title: Essential surjectivity of canonical finite etale descent
statement: Let g:Y' -> Y be a surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] map of schemes. Let F and q satisfy [lem-galois-descent-data-existence]. Then every finite etale descent datum A [def-galois-finite-etale-descent-data] is isomorphic to F(P) for some finite etale Y-scheme P [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category].

source.place: Proof; corrected Stacks route recorded in node lem-galois-descent

proof.text: Mathlib singleton_mem_fppfPrecoverage and fppfPrecoverage_le_fpqcPrecoverage make g an fpqc covering. A finite morphism is affine. Apply effective affine descent to A.
The standard pullback of the descended object is isomorphic to A, hence finite etale. Apply isFinite_of_fpqc_cover and etale_of_fpqc_cover to the PUnit singleton family.

The descended finite etale scheme P and the projection equations yield two pullback squares. Their unique comparison isomorphism and its inverse preserve transport: compare both projections and use invariance and pullback uniqueness. Lift this isomorphism to the finite etale descent-data full subcategory.
